events.description: Married William B. Cucey Jr. (DC marriage record) [R4-S1]

bio: Mathilde C. Payne was born on 8 August 1891, the daughter of Richard Payne and Maria Colton. She first married William B. Cucey Jr. in Washington, D.C., on 21 November 1911, and then Leo G. Heffernan at Chicago on 24 December 1915. Later in life she was known as Mrs. McLaughlin. She died on 14 November 1972 and was buried at Mount Olivet Cemetery in Washington, D.C.
